briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P 500 +0.3%), but with $1,289 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed capital into AMZN, TSLA, and ESAB, which show confirmed bullish momentum (MACD crossovers, healthy RSI, price above SMA-20). None had full 4-signal confirmation (no volume surge), so sizing is medium conviction rather than high.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag refers to the opportunity cost of holding uninvested cash instead of putting it to work in the market. With open portfolio slots and cash above the deployment threshold, letting money sit idle on a neutral day can mean missing out on gains that invested capital could have captured.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 現金拖累（Cash Drag）是指持有未投資現金而產生的機會成本。當投資組合仍有空位、現金亦超過部署門檻時，若在普通（中性）市況下仍讓資金閒置，便可能錯失本可透過投資獲取的潛在回報。

market_education.summary_en: Today's market action was quiet and directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 up a modest 0.3%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to major catalysts. Without strong risk-on or risk-off signals, momentum names with confirmed technical setups (MACD crossovers, healthy RSI) stood out as the more reliable opportunities. No single headline is driving today's tape, so stock-specific technical strength became the deciding factor for new positions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現平淡，納指及標普500同樣僅微升0.3%，反映投資者普遍採取觀望態度，未有明顯方向性消息刺激市場。在缺乏強烈的風險偏好或避險訊號下，具備確認技術形態（如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間）的強勢股顯得較為可靠。由於今日未見主導市場的重大新聞，個股技術面強弱成為選股的關鍵考量。
